content:
Data & Royalties Operations | Builder

Hi, I'm Jose. I've spent 10+ years in music, at Warner Chappell, SoundCloud and Meta, turning messy royalty and partner data into systems people can trust.

I'm a data engineer and operations leader at heart: SQL, Python, BigQuery and pipelines on one side, and the teams, partners and processes they serve on the other.

These days I also build end-to-end products with a team of AI agents, from idea to shipped, tested and deployed. Take a look at Systems & Data, or say hello.

Before all that I was a musician, designer and public diplomat, which is why this site looks the way it does.
